column3: The duties and functions of the Board shall be-

(a)
to register security rights of movable property
under Part VI of this Act;

(b)
to register the rights of judgment creditors;

(c)
to  determine  the  policies  related  to  the
registration system maintained by the Bureau;

(d)
subject  to  the  provisions  of  this  Act,  to
determine the  fees or any other charges to be
levied for services rendered by the Authority;

(e)
to  perform  and  discharge  such  duties  and
functions that are specifically imposed on the
Board by or under this Act.
